definitions.explanation: The temperature of the body, typically measured to check for fever or illness.

examples.japanese: {体温|たいおん}を{測|はか}ってください。
{体温|たいおん}が38{度|ど}もある。
examples.english: My temperature is as high as 38 degrees.

examples.japanese: {病院|びょういん}に{入|はい}る{前|まえ}に{体温|たいおん}チェックがあった。
examples.english: There was a temperature check before entering the hospital.

notes:
{体温|たいおん} refers to the temperature of a living body. Compound of {体|たい} (body) + {温|おん} (temperature).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {体温|たいおん}を{測|はか}る: to take one's temperature
- {体温|たいおん}が{上|あ}がる: temperature rises
- {体温|たいおん}が{下|さ}がる: temperature drops
- {体温|たいおん}チェック: temperature check

COMPOUNDS:
- {体温計|たいおんけい}: thermometer (body temperature)
- {低体温|ていたいおん}: hypothermia
- {平熱|へいねつ}: normal body temperature

CULTURAL NOTE:
Normal body temperature in Japan is typically considered around 36-37°C. Japan uses Celsius exclusively. Temperature checks became ubiquitous at building entrances during health screening periods.

RELATED:
- {熱|ねつ}: fever / heat
- {気温|きおん}: air temperature (weather)
